Skeleton Mage (Undead)
Returned Mage, Bone Mage, Burning Dead Mage, Horror Mage

These animated skeletal remains of slain sorcerers wield the forces of elemental magic as they sow death throughout the land. Able to deliver considerable damage from a distance, these undead mages can be exceptionally dangerous when congregating in large pacts or under the direction of the remains of a particularly powerful caster.

Tips and Other Additional Information
Skeleton Mages are Undead and are vulnerable to Undead-specific spells and abilities.

Skeleton Mages have elemental attacks such as Poison, Cold, Fire, and Lightning. Stats are listed for Poison, Cold, Fire and Lightning version of Skeleton Mages, respectively, while Burning Dead Mages only have 3 variations.
